## Summary

`MaybeStripAnsi` in `src/click/_termui_impl.py` subclasses `io.TextIOWrapper` directly but never overrode `__del__`. When it wraps a borrowed stream (e.g. the cached default stdout, via the `_pipepager`/`_tempfilepager` fallback branches that run when no `PAGER` is set or the command isn't found), the default `IOBase.__del__` calls `close()` on garbage collection — closing the shared, cached stdout wrapper and producing "I/O operation on closed file" on later writes (#3449). The `_SkipClose` wrapper from #3482 only guarded the `_nullpager` path, not this one.

Fixed by giving `MaybeStripAnsi` the same `__del__` pattern already used by `_NonClosingTextIOWrapper` in `_compat.py`: call `detach()` instead of letting GC implicitly `close()` the underlying stream. Also added a `CHANGES.rst` entry. Full test suite (1584 tests) passes against the local source.
